facts.raw_span: an asymptomatic slightly reddish verrucous plaque on the right temple
nail sized when first noticed 1½ years earlier
gradually developed over the 8 months prior to presentation
denied any associated fevers, weight loss, or night sweats
slightly reddish verrucous mass with translucent papules and plaques on the right temple, about 5 cm in diameter
surface hemorrhagic crust in the side adjacent to right eyebrow arch
nontender with no purulent discharge and no severe necrotic changes
no hepatosplenomegaly or superficial lymphadenopathy
Blood cell counts, urinalysis, and kidney and hepatic panels revealed no abnormalities
Skin thickening and a soft-tissue mass in the right frontotemporal region near the orbit
No evidence of metastases
Papillomatous epidermal hyperplasia, edema of dermal papillae, and neoplastic infiltration consisting of small round blue cells with alternating areas of dense and loose cellularity

concepts.why: The presence of a verrucous mass with surface hemorrhagic crust, skin thickening, and a soft-tissue mass near the orbit, along with histopathological findings of small round blue cells and positive immunohistochemistry for MyoD1 and myogenin, are consistent with rhabdomyosarcoma.

The age of the patient, the location of the tumor, and the histopathological findings of small round blue cells with alternating areas of dense and loose cellularity are consistent with embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma.

rationales.F01: The presence of a reddish verrucous plaque is suggestive of a skin tumor, which is consistent with Rhabdomyosarcoma and Embryonal Rhabdomyosarcoma.
rationales.F05: The description of the mass as slightly reddish and verrucous is consistent with Rhabdomyosarcoma and Embryonal Rhabdomyosarcoma.
rationales.F06: The presence of a surface hemorrhagic crust may indicate aggressive tumor behavior, which is consistent with Rhabdomyosarcoma and Embryonal Rhabdomyosarcoma.
rationales.F10: The imaging findings of skin thickening and a soft-tissue mass are consistent with Rhabdomyosarcoma and Embryonal Rhabdomyosarcoma.
rationales.F12: The histopathological findings of papillomatous epidermal hyperplasia and neoplastic infiltration with small round blue cells are highly suggestive of Rhabdomyosarcoma and Embryonal Rhabdomyosarcoma.

frontier_selector.rationale: The presence of small round blue cells with alternating areas of dense and loose cellularity, positive for MyoD1 and myogenin, is more characteristic of Embryonal Rhabdomyosarcoma, a subtype of Rhabdomyosarcoma.
